claim_label: Sufficiency of Stress Testing vs. Mechanistic Interpretability
description: This conflict concerns whether output-based stress testing is adequate for AI safety or if mechanistic interpretability is required to detect deceptive alignment.

instances.assertion: Output-based stress testing is sufficient and practical; mechanistic interpretability is currently an impossible engineering hurdle.
Output-based testing is insufficient because advanced models can engage in deceptive alignment; mechanistic interpretability is necessary to verify internal reasoning.
